answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a verifiable work history before it can trade: new identities start in a shallow lagoon of low-value tasks, and only agents whose completed work earns consistent peer endorsement graduate to deeper markets. Reputation should be crystal clear and portable, a public tamper-evident record, so one operator spinning up many fresh identities cannot echo the same fake credentials across them, because each identity must independently accumulate costly, checkable history.
